name: Nitrogen Fixation
notes: Nitrogen fixation via nitrogenase enzyme complex. Two alternative systems: Mo-nitrogenase (nif) and V-nitrogenase (vnf). Both reduce N2 to NH3.

nodes.name: nitrogenase molybdenum-iron protein alpha chain
nodes.notes: Alpha chain of Mo-nitrogenase MoFe protein

nodes.name: nitrogenase molybdenum-iron protein beta chain
nodes.notes: Beta chain of Mo-nitrogenase MoFe protein

nodes.name: nitrogenase iron protein
nodes.notes: Fe protein, electron donor to MoFe protein (DIAGNOSTIC for nitrogen fixation)

nodes.name: vanadium-dependent nitrogenase alpha chain
nodes.notes: Alpha chain of V-nitrogenase VFe protein (alternative to Mo-nitrogenase)

nodes.name: vanadium-dependent nitrogenase beta chain
nodes.notes: Beta chain of V-nitrogenase VFe protein

nodes.name: vanadium nitrogenase iron protein
nodes.notes: Fe protein for V-nitrogenase (alternative to nifH)

edges.notes: nifH donates electrons to nifDK complex
vnfD and vnfK form alternative nitrogenase complex
vnfH donates electrons to vnfDKG complex

scoring.notes: Organism has N2 fixation if: (nifD + nifK + nifH) OR (vnfD + vnfK + vnfG + vnfH). nifH is key diagnostic gene.
